items.stem: Which Azure Virtual Desktop object delivers a single published application rather than a full desktop?

options.text: RemoteApp published through a RemoteApp application group
options.rationale: Correct: a RemoteApp published in a RemoteApp application group delivers one app, not a full desktop.
A personal desktop assignment gives a full dedicated desktop.
Windows 365 Cloud PC is a separate product, not an AVD RemoteApp.
Azure Bastion provides secure admin access to VMs, not app delivery.

items.explanation: Correct: a RemoteApp published in a RemoteApp application group delivers one app, not a full desktop.

items.stem: For session hosts joined only to Microsoft Entra ID, what enables single sign-on to Azure Virtual Desktop?

options.text: Configuring Microsoft Entra single sign-on with the required Kerberos and Conditional Access settings
options.rationale: Correct: Entra-joined hosts require the Entra SSO configuration plus supporting settings for single sign-on.

options.text: Joining the hosts to AD DS only
options.rationale: AD DS-only join does not provide Entra SSO for Entra-joined hosts.

options.text: Using local accounts on each session host
options.rationale: Local accounts do not support single sign-on.
Disabling MFA weakens security and does not enable SSO.

items.explanation: Correct: Entra-joined hosts require the Entra SSO configuration plus supporting settings for single sign-on.

Correct: Azure NetApp Files is a supported FSLogix profile container location.
Azure Table storage is a NoSQL store, not a file share for profiles.
An ephemeral OS disk is wiped on deallocation and cannot hold profiles.
